title: group_list_members — output
description: Output schema for the SOX group_list_members operation. Returns the group_id and the current list of members, optionally annotated with presence state. Normative reference: spec/primitives/groups.md §5.5.

group_id.description: The full group channel name, echoed from the input.

members.description: Current membership list. Each entry represents one agent in the group.

status.description: 'active' means the agent has joined. 'invited' means the invite was sent but not yet accepted.

joined_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when the agent joined or was invited.

presence_state.description: Current presence state from sox/presence when include_presence=true; null otherwise or when no presence record exists.
